consequence.statement: For environments that pass --no-proxy, the flag's value is now stored in the correct variable instead of a wrong one, so no-proxy handling behaves differently after the upgrade.
consequence.remediation: If you pass --no-proxy to an Argo CD binary, verify proxy-exclusion behavior after upgrading to v3.0.0.

assertion.statement: Argo CD v3.0.0 fixes a CLI bug in which the value of the --no-proxy flag was stored in the wrong variable.
